headline: Going Commando USA v1.01 reaches 84.74% matched code
summary: Going Commando's USA v1.01 now has 7,760 of 8,579 functions matching, covering 84.74% of code by size, up from 66.51%. Matching means the reconstructed C compiles to the same bytes as the original game. The day's 500,097 added and 85,007 removed lines include a large multi-release batch: #386 accounts for 353,072 additions and 23,882 deletions.
highlights: #386 reports USA v2.00 at 7,586 of 8,634 functions and 80.93% of code, and Europe/Australia at 6,992 of 8,672 and 54.14%; these are that PR's measured figures, not the final USA v1.01 progress total.
#384 supplies 453 matching boot and level functions; #386 includes the lock-on tether family and compiler fixes.
Thirteen more functions in Yeedil and Aranos prison landed, alongside a correction for PAL and USA v2.00 (#387).
The shared helper `func_00292078` matches at all 28 USA v1.01 placements (#388).
Functional C for the native port remains an unmerged draft and adds no matches to the report (#389).
